items.title: NOWS: Neural Operator Warm Starts for accelerating iterative solvers
items.source: Computer Methods in Applied Mechanics and Engineering
items.excerpt: NOWS uses neural operators to generate warm starts for classical Krylov solvers while retaining established discretizations and iterative convergence behavior; the authors report end-to-end runtime reductions of up to 90% across tested PDE benchmarks.
items.query: neural operator engineering simulation August 2026
items.organization: Computer Methods in Applied Mechanics and Engineering

items.title: Koopman-inspired operator learning for intrinsic flame instabilities
items.excerpt: A Koopman-inspired Fourier neural operator is evaluated on DNS data for nonlinear flame instabilities; the paper reports 2–6x lower errors than a standard FNO while improving short-term prediction and long-term statistical fidelity.
items.query: August 2026 neural operator flame CFD engineering

items.title: Machine-Learning-Based Real-Time Trajectory Prediction of Store Release from Cavity
items.excerpt: The study builds a data-driven reduced-order model from 2D inviscid CFD using dynamic-time-warping clustering, POD and SVM regression to predict cavity-store trajectories in real time, while noting weaker prediction of higher-order modes.
items.query: August 2026 AI CFD surrogate aerospace real-time reduced order model

items.title: Digital Twin Engineering with Physics-Informed Neural Networks: State of the Art and Open Challenges
items.source: Archives of Computational Methods in Engineering
items.excerpt: This review surveys PINN-based digital-twin engineering, focusing on state estimation from sparse sensors, adaptive calibration, degradation and environmental variability, and open challenges in keeping physical assets synchronized with virtual models.
items.query: August 2026 digital twin physics informed neural network engineering review

items.title: PARSEC.py: A Python-Based Real-Space Kohn–Sham Density Functional Theory Code Accelerated by Machine Learned Charge Density
items.excerpt: PARSEC.py provides a Python real-space Kohn–Sham DFT framework and uses machine-learned charge density to accelerate first-principles electronic-structure workflows while retaining controllable real-space numerical accuracy and parallelization.
items.query: August 2026 DFT machine learned charge density computational chemistry

items.title: Broadening access to Skala creates a faster path to predictive DFT
items.excerpt: Microsoft Research released Skala 1.1, an updated deep-learning exchange-correlation functional, and highlighted integration into computational-chemistry software including a validated CP2K interface, moving learned models inside established DFT workflows.
items.query: Skala 1.1 Microsoft Research August 2026 DFT

items.title: Enhancing materials discovery with valence-constrained design in generative modeling
items.excerpt: CrysVCD integrates oxidation-state constraints into crystal generation; the authors report much faster valence checking than post-screening and, after stability fine-tuning, 85% of candidates below 0.1 eV/atom Ehull and 68% phonon stability.
items.query: scientific AI materials crystal generative model August 2026

items.title: DFT-based machine-learning for the rational design of magnetocaloric high-entropy alloys
items.excerpt: The study combines DFT-derived data with machine learning to search and rationally design magnetocaloric high-entropy alloys, providing a recent materials-design example where first-principles calculations and ML jointly reduce the candidate space.
items.query: August 2026 DFT machine learning high entropy alloy materials design

items.title: Previewing the Model Hardware Standard
items.excerpt: Anthropic introduced a research preview of Model Hardware Standard, a shared specification for agents to operate lab and manufacturing instruments such as microscopes, liquid handlers and robot arms; the company targets much lower bespoke integration effort.
items.query: Anthropic Model Hardware Standard August 2026 lab manufacturing agent

items.title: Salesforce Turns Enterprise Applications into Enterprise Capabilities
items.excerpt: Salesforce expanded Headless 360 with MCP servers that let authorized agents discover and invoke governed business capabilities. A Data 360 MCP Server exposes nearly 200 APIs while preserving identity, permissions, workflows and validation rules.
items.query: Salesforce Headless 360 MCP August 2026 enterprise agents

items.title: Salesforce and Anthropic launch Claudeforce
items.excerpt: Claudeforce connects Claude with Salesforce data, workflows, business logic and governance. The initial Salesforce-in-Claude plugin includes 37 prebuilt sales skills and uses Salesforce AIforce with MCP servers, APIs and CLI tooling.
items.query: Salesforce Anthropic Claudeforce August 2026 MCP enterprise workflow

items.title: Huawei Cloud CodeArts Agent Now Available across Asia Pacific
items.excerpt: Huawei Cloud moved CodeArts Agent from public beta to commercial availability for international Asia-Pacific users, combining code models, IDE functions and autonomous development workflows including code generation, engineering Q&A and automated unit tests.
items.query: Huawei Cloud CodeArts Agent August 2026 Asia Pacific

items.title: Kimi Code v0.39.0 adds experimental Tower multi-agent orchestration
items.excerpt: Kimi Code v0.39.0 added experimental Tower mode for coordinating multiple agents toward one objective, conversation-forked subagents, remote control for local web sessions and independent AgentSwarm timeout controls.
items.query: Kimi Code August 2026 multi-agent Tower orchestration

items.title: The New MCP Roadmap
items.excerpt: MCP maintainers published a roadmap prioritizing agentic messaging primitives, HTTP-native transport hardening, agent identity and enterprise-ready security, improved protocol primitives and SDK developer experience for upcoming specification work.
items.query: MCP roadmap August 2026 agent identity enterprise security

items.title: Path to Astra: critical capabilities and frontier safeguards
items.excerpt: OpenAI says Astra is its first model designated at the Preparedness Framework's Critical cybersecurity threshold. The company reports a 100% ExploitBench score, two zero-days found in an internal recent-vulnerability set, and stronger deployment controls.

items.title: The state of AI in 2026: On the road to ROI
items.excerpt: McKinsey's survey of 1,719 respondents in 97 nations reports large organizations scaling agents faster, 80% reporting personal productivity gains, 37% reporting positive EBIT contribution, and coding agents influencing software insourcing decisions.

items.title: AI Agents are Only the Beginning: Deloitte Survey Examines the AI Readiness Gap
items.excerpt: Deloitte reports that only 5% of surveyed organizations say their processes are highly prepared for AI agents and 15% have scaled orchestrated cross-functional multi-agent adoption; 74% expect major process redesign around agents within four years.
items.query: Deloitte agentic AI readiness survey August 2026 workflow redesign

items.title: Gartner Survey Finds AI Spending by Customer Service Leaders Has Surged by 38%
items.excerpt: A Gartner survey of 199 service and support leaders conducted in April-May 2026 found AI spending up 38% while overall function budgets rose 2%, indicating budget reallocation toward GenAI, voicebots and agentic AI platforms.

items.title: Companies Keep Spending on AI Despite Roadblocks on Returns
items.excerpt: Teradata summarizes a survey of 1,000 senior technology and data leaders: 90% expect to increase agentic-AI investment over the next year while 37% report measurable business impact, with the vendor emphasizing data foundations and measurement gaps.
items.query: Teradata Arrested Automation August 2026 agentic AI ROI survey

items.title: Strong majority of Japanese firms have yet to fully embrace AI: Reuters poll
items.excerpt: A Reuters/Nikkei Research survey of 219 responding Japanese companies found 60% using AI only in limited parts of operations and 16% reporting company-wide deployment as an integral tool; none of the respondents planned to cut AI spending.

items.title: Adoption of Generative AI in the Workplace: Increasing and Shifting the Balance of Productivity and Communication Activity
items.excerpt: Using Microsoft M365 digital traces across multiple large international companies, the study reports that heavy AI users showed 21.2% more productivity-app actions and 7.1% more communication actions over a 20-week post-adoption period.

items.title: Early days: The state of agentic AI in IT
items.excerpt: Fixify analyzes 17,929 agentic plans, 147,351 plan actions and 52,689 skill executions from more than 40 companies, describing routine agent execution combined with analyst supervision, approval, redirection and takeover.

items.title: Tencent Releases and Open-Sources Tencent Hy4 preview
items.excerpt: Tencent released and open-sourced Hy4 preview with 770B total parameters, 49B active parameters and a context window exceeding 1M tokens, targeting coding, office work and scientific research workloads.
items.query: Tencent Hy4 preview August 2026 open source model

items.title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next: A New Architecture, Towards Ultimate Cost-Efficiency
items.excerpt: Qwen released the open-weight multimodal Qwen3.8-Flash-Next as an early Qwen4 architecture preview. The model uses a sparse MoE design with 125B backbone parameters and 6B active per token, plus hybrid attention and efficiency-oriented architectural changes.
items.query: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next August 26 2026 open weights architecture

items.title: GLM-5.3-Flash: More Intelligence with Less Compute
items.excerpt: Z.ai released GLM-5.3-Flash, a natively multimodal 320B-total/18B-active model using hybrid sparse and linear attention plus Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections; weights are available through the zai-org Hugging Face organization.
items.query: GLM-5.3-Flash August 2026 Z.ai open weights multimodal

items.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning Delivers Fast, Accurate Specialized Task Execution for Long-Running Agents
items.excerpt: NVIDIA released Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, a 30B MoE with 3B active parameters designed for high-volume, low-latency work inside long-running agents; BF16 and NVFP4 checkpoints and customization tooling are part of the open release.

items.title: Introducing Shieldstral
items.excerpt: Mistral released Shieldstral, a 3B Apache-2.0 open-weight multimodal safety classifier that accepts plain-language moderation policies at inference time and is designed to run on a single 16GB NVIDIA GPU.

items.title: Introducing Endeavor 1.0 from Flower Labs
items.excerpt: Flower Labs introduced Endeavor 1.0, a production-oriented frontier generalist for reasoning, coding and long-horizon agent work, initially in preview with options for Flower-operated service or deployment inside customer-controlled infrastructure.

items.excerpt: Sakana AI launched the Namazu API, a Japanese-specialized model based on the open Kimi K2.6 model and tuned for Japanese language and business context, with built-in web search and code execution through an OpenAI-compatible API.
